07106 qatsa` {kaw-tsah'}

字根型; TWOT - 2056,2057; 動詞

AV - cause to scrape 1, corner 1; 2

1) 擦, 刮除, 切掉
   1a) (Hiphil) 刮除
2) 使有角落, 放在角落處
   2a) (Hophal) 被置於角落, 使有拐角之處
record.edic_text:
07106 qatsa` {kaw-tsah'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 2056,2057; v

AV - cause to scrape 1, corner 1; 2

1) to scrape, scrape off, cut off
   1a) (Hiphil) to scrape
2) to be cornered, be set in corners
   2a) (Hophal) to cut off places, make corners
